package main

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/system-inc/adamic/internal/javascript"
	"github.com/system-inc/adamic/internal/load"
	"github.com/system-inc/adamic/internal/lower"
	"github.com/system-inc/adamic/internal/native"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	p, e := load.Load([]string{os.Args[1]})
	if e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
	l, e := lower.Lower(context.Background(), p)
	if e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(os.Args[2]+".mjs", []byte(javascript.JavaScript(l)), 0644); e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
	if e = native.Build(native.C(l), os.Args[2], native.Options{Sanitize: true}); e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
}
